Durante una entrevista, Mbappé dijo: "con el que más me he reído es ese en el que usan mi cara en un dictador chino. Lo utilizo mucho con mis amigos". La polémica ha tenido consecuencias comerciales y deportivas: tres empresas cancelaron su colaboración con el futbolista y el grupo CMG, que controla la televisión pública, suspendió la retransmisión de partidos de LaLiga… Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: New York’s High Line to Open Final Garden Featuring 2,000 Perennials in November
item.description: This November, New York City's High Line will unveil its final garden at West 34th Street, culminating a transformative journey from an old freight line to a vibrant public park. Boasting 2,000 perennials alongside newly paved pathways and informative signage, this garden is distinctive in its grounded plantings. When finished, the High Line will welcome millions of annual visitors to enjoy its beauty and tranquility. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: A personal letter from Martha Washington, describing her daughter's recovery, has found a new home at the Library of Congress. item.description: Landon Hoberman, a 17-year-old from New Jersey, has made remarkable strides in reducing plastic cutlery usage in restaurants.
